envelope.description: Verify modifying dispatch and qualification ownership

body.title: Verify modifying dispatch and qualification ownership
body.summary: Replace the fixed modifying-method minimum in src/daemon/__tests__/repo-gate-dispatch.test.ts with exact identity coverage. Preserve positive registered writes and existing refusal controls; verify qualificationState dispatch and directly affected ownership/refusal boundaries in isolated fixtures. Put the isolated unqualified qualificationState control in src/daemon/__tests__/handler-runtime.test.ts and class/target assertions in src/daemon/threads/__tests__/method-class.test.ts. Account explicitly for the settings writer's structured registration refusal and tools.call's existing malformed/earlier-executor outcomes versus final repository authority.
acceptanceChecks: Every modifying registered RPC/stream is exercised and counted by exact name. Generic gates retain repo refusal behavior; self-gated settings and tools.call preserve their existing structural/registration envelopes and refuse unauthorized admitted mutations without filesystem changes, even with conflicting cwd/environment.
Positive artifact.feedback.append still writes only the named registered repository; all repository gate tests and supported token/path controls pass.

An isolated full-runtime qualificationState call reaches its existing unqualified error, not an unknown-method or fabricated success; class/route evidence excludes the admin-only map and shared-state owner.

Directly affected retired-review dispatcher/router controls preserve local no-work refusal without provider calls, worker allocation or writes. Tests use managed children and no installed live stores.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/repo-gate-dispatch.test.ts — exact modifying dispatch coverage, no-write refusal and positive registered feedback append.
src/daemon/__tests__/handler-runtime.test.ts — isolated qualificationState reaches existing unqualified error.
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/method-class.test.ts — qualification ordinary session target, excluding admin/shared/FIFO ownership.
src/daemon/__tests__/repo-call-gate.test.ts and src/daemon/__tests__/step-repo-gate.test.ts — canonical repo/path/token refusal and continuation controls.
